training.loss_note: E/N scale0.01eV, force0.05eV/A, stress0.001eV/A^3. DPA4 intensive virial/N approximates stress using fixed17A^3/atom; native tensor averaging differs, common validation score is authoritative.
training.optimizer: Adam, no EMA, all native trainable parameters; no architecture/type-map reduction
training.initialization: Original pinned foundation weights, not synthetic fine-tuned checkpoints; DeepMD train-only bias/statistics adjustment recorded; GRACE shift=false

selection.score: Mean of squared full-validation RMSE/scale for train-aligned E/N, force components, six stress components
selection.energy_alignment: Fit one additive eV/Al shift per checkpoint on train only; freeze for validation and final test; report raw and aligned energies
selection.tie_break: Smallest training progress at exactly equal score
selection.baseline_fallback: If original checkpoint has the lowest validation score, retain it explicitly and report no validated adaptation benefit
selection.test_gate: No test labels in training/selection payload. Open test member from verified private DFT archive only after both immutable selections and selected-weight hashes are locked.
selection.normalizers_are: Fixed comparison scales, not an accuracy qualification or tuned acceptance thresholds

evaluation: Re-evaluate original and selected models on same A100; identical raw/aligned energy and force/stress MAE/RMSE/bias/max by split and parent; no test-based selection or further tuning
authorization: User explicitly requested DPA4/GRACE fine-tuning through Slurm on A100, train fitting, validation checkpoint selection, test final comparison; bounded one-seed pilot only
limitations: 21 training structures only; no universal teacher qualification
Prior baseline test results were inspected but must not set this run's model/checkpoint/sampling choices
No pretraining-independent generalization claim; PAW54/PAW64 differences and narrow DFT convergence remain
No MD stability, EOS, interface or distillation validation
